data.value: Will the neighbors on Alder Court fill all fourteen slots of the meal train they started for the Okafor family within four days?

A meal train sign-up for the Okafor family (who have newborn twins) has been posted on the neighborhood app for Alder Court, which has about sixty households. The sign-up has fourteen slots. As of the start time, eight slots have been claimed, leaving six slots unfilled. The sign-up is visible to all members of the app.
